description:
DepthWeaver turns real-world depth into Magic Eye stereograms. Capture a scene with the LiDAR scanner, generate depth from any photo with on-device AI, scan a real object with Apple's Object Capture, or load a 3D model — then watch a hidden image rise out of the noise as you cross your eyes.

CAPTURE DEPTH FIVE WAYS
• LiDAR live capture on iPhone Pro — point, freeze, done
• On-device AI depth from any photo (Depth Anything V2)
• Scan real objects with Apple's Object Capture (Pro devices) — guided orbits turn a real object into a .usdz you can orbit and frame
• 3D model import — .usdz, .usd, .obj, .scn with an orbit camera so you choose the angle
• Bundled height map and 3D model presets to play with right away

PICK A PATTERN
• Six procedural generators: random dot, stars, Perlin noise, Worley noise, Voronoi cells, reaction-diffusion
• Import any image from your photo library as a custom tile
• Built-in texture library

TUNE EVERY KNOB
• DPI, depth strength, separation, oversampling
• Remap input and output depth ranges to push the subject forward or back
• Denoise quantized 8-bit imports for clean, banding-free output
• Invert depth in one tap
• Live preview redraws as you slide

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on device. No account, no upload, no tracking, no ads. Your photos and 3D scans never leave your iPhone.

UNDER THE HOOD
Parallelized implementation of the Thimbleby–Inglis–Witten autostereogram algorithm with W. A. Steer's link-based hidden-surface refinement. Powered by ARKit, Object Capture, Core ML, SceneKit, Metal, and Core Image. Output is upscaled so the minimum dimension is at least 960 px — print-ready or share-ready.

SHARE
Export high-resolution PNGs to Photos, Messages, AirDrop, or any app with a share sheet.

Available in English and French. iPhone, iOS 17+.

Capture a scene. Pick a pattern. Stare into it.
promotionalText: Turn any scene into a Magic Eye illusion: LiDAR depth, AI from a photo, a scanned real object, or any 3D model — six procedural patterns, real-time preview, share-ready.
whatsNew:
What's new in 1.2:

• A brand-new look. The main screen is now built around the stereogram itself — a full-bleed canvas with a frosted-glass tool drawer that slides out of the way when you want to look.
• Learn to see it. A built-in trainer walks you through the cross-eye technique, step by step, until the hidden image snaps into focus.
• Depth presets. Soft, Standard and Punchy give you a good-looking result in one tap — fine-tune from there if you want.
• See your depth in 3D. The depth-source screen now shows a live 3D point cloud of what you captured, so you know what you're working with before you weave it.
• Faster photo depth. AI depth estimation no longer blocks the interface — the app stays responsive while it thinks.
• The 3D model screen, the result view and the depth adjustment controls have all been rebuilt to match, plus a pile of fixes.

Capture a scene. Pick a pattern. Stare into it.
